name: Marmita do abrigo
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: extremely simple pickup sprite and matching HUD icon for a Sega Mega Drive game.
Create Marmita do abrigo. A simple RED rectangular lunchbox with rounded corners, a broad WHITE lid partly opened, and just one cream rice patch inside. Bold RED lower half and WHITE top half. RED + CREAM + DARK RED only. Obvious little lunchbox, not abstract machinery.
The previous realistic small sprites were UNREADABLE on a busy brown game floor. This replacement MUST look like an obvious bright arcade collectible, not a scrap scenery prop. Use the clarity of old 8-bit pickup glyphs. Just one dominant silhouette and one BIG functional symbol, no bolts, no rust, no texture, no brass, no tiny highlights, no dither, no volume shading, no perspective complexity. Some top surface visible for an overhead game, but icon clarity first.
CRITICAL: draw a THICK CONTINUOUS SOLID CREAM-WHITE OUTER OUTLINE around the COMPLETE silhouette, INCLUDING top, bottom, left, right, and concave edges. White outline must be 2 logical pixels thick on the large version, 1 logical pixel thick on the small version, so it survives export and contrasts with both brown and green floors. Do NOT use a black exterior outline. A few black INSIDE pixels allowed only if essential.
Exactly TWO objects side by side, on actual TRANSPARENT background: LEFT a very simple 16x16 logical-pixel pickup, RIGHT a separately simplified 8x8 logical-pixel matching HUD glyph. Same pixel enlargement for both, right exactly half the size. Use large perfectly square flat-color pixel blocks and straight staircase edges. White contour like a clean pixel sticker. Leave a generous transparent gap between the two objects.
Color constraints: at most THREE visible solid colors besides transparent, from the subject description. WHITE must be #dbdbb6 (existing game white), red #b62424, yellow #dbb624, green #499224, blue #2449b6, cyan #24b6db, orange #db6d24, dark red #492400, dark green #496d6d, black #000000. No other colors, no gradients, no soft shadow, no glow, no anti-aliasing.
No text, no grid, no numbers, no scene, no characters, no presentation shadow. Focus on readable bold simple pickup shapes, with a clean unbroken white outside border, even at 8 pixels.
